title: Description: When BIG-IP APM is provisioned, an Access Profile is configured as a SAML SP (Service Provider) and is…
description: A vulnerability in BIG-IP APM occurs when an Access Profile configured as a SAML Service Provider is applied to a virtual server. Undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate, resulting in a denial-of-service (DoS) condition. This issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. The vulnerability allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to disrupt traffic by causing the TMM process to restart.
